svg.aria-label: documentation: Any work product, documented one way. Seven skeletons, one house theme, PDF + DOCX, then merge or stamp. Steps: Gather, the facts from the work; Ground, checked against the source; Summarize, into the right skeleton; Build, Markdown to PDF + DOCX; Merge, annexes and stamps via pdf-lib. Output: a matching PDF and DOCX, changes highlighted.
